items.notes: Current app proves synthetic FHIR-shaped evidence. AWS EKS, RDS, Medplum sandbox deployment, and CSO hire remain open.
Deterministic synthetic generation exists; LangGraph/DrASSIST orchestration is not built.
Transcription fallback exists. Vendor NLP/voice accuracy evidence is not complete.
Safety flags and benchmark coverage exist. Named SHIELD/EQUITY agents and graph DB are not built.
Synthetic benchmarks pass. Formal clinical F1/triage studies are not complete.
Evidence readiness exists. DCB0129 safety case draft and DTAC pre-submission are not complete.
No EMIS sandbox or GP pilot-site selection is complete.
VOICE agent and SystmOne preparation are future roadmap items.
IntelliProve, mental health bundle, and biomarker schema validation are not started.
Real-patient pilots remain blocked until safety, privacy, infrastructure, and partner governance are ready.
Federated learning and RWE pipeline are not started.
DCB0129 submission, DTAC approval, MHRA pathway, and NHS App prep are not complete.

m1Checklist.title: CSO job spec finalized + RCGP/NMC/GPhC reach-out
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Clinical Safety Officer candidate pipeline identified and interview process scheduled.
m1Checklist.notes: This is a real-world hiring/governance blocker, not an app feature.

m1Checklist.title: EMIS Web Partner Programme application submitted
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Formal acknowledgement or next-step email from EMIS is captured.
m1Checklist.notes: Do not claim EMIS integration until partner/sandbox pathway is confirmed.

m1Checklist.title: DTAC/DCB0129 regulatory consultant engaged
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Consultant contract signed and kickoff booked.
m1Checklist.notes: Current product evidence can support the conversation but is not a safety case.

m1Checklist.title: AWS London EKS/RDS decision and implementation plan
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Architecture decision record exists with environment, cost, security, and migration assumptions.
m1Checklist.notes: The app remains JSON-backed proof-stage; production-style infrastructure is not deployed.

m1Checklist.title: Synthetic validation scope locked
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Scenario classes, expected outcomes, benchmark gates, and evidence exports are documented.
m1Checklist.notes: The synthetic benchmark suite exists; formal validation scope still needs sign-off.

m1Checklist.title: Medplum/FHIR sandbox plan
m1Checklist.doneWhen: FHIR resource plan and sandbox boundaries are documented without enabling live sync by default.
m1Checklist.notes: Current FHIR output is evidence-shaped; Medplum sync remains gated off.

m1Checklist.title: Hazard log template aligned to DCB0129/clinical safety work
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Hazard log framework exists with owners, mitigations, evidence links, and open assumptions.
m1Checklist.notes: A regulatory folder exists, but this still needs accountable clinical safety review.

m1Checklist.title: Safety committee and first review board scheduled
m1Checklist.doneWhen: Meeting date, attendees, agenda, and evidence pack are captured.
m1Checklist.notes: Keep this as planned until a named safety owner is accountable.
